programmes.d: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.
Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.
The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."
The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.
An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.
Two unhappy children find a happy escape in a swimming pool.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
A bored, wealthy businessman gets a chance to go back in time and start over, armed with all the knowledge he's acquired.

At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.
The curator of a murderers' row in a soon-to-be-defunct wax museum persuades the owner to let him keep the figures for awhile.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.
Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.
Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.
Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policeman try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.
Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.
A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.
A scientist creates an android that has the qualities which he feels he's lacking.
An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.
Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...
After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.
